description: Red Sea crisis: Suez Canal traffic impacts is a dataset listed in Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX), an open data portal, published or maintained by OCHA Regional Office for Southern and Eastern Africa (ROSEA). The attacks in the Red Sea are disrupting commercial and humanitarian supplies. International partners have raised alarm over the economic and humanitarian impact of the escalating attacks on ships in the Red Sea which are adding strain to shipping routes already hit by conflicts and climate change. Coverage: not tied to one country in the listing. The portal files it under the publisher OCHA Regional Office for Southern and Eastern Africa (ROSEA). Its tags are energy, food security, logistics, trade. It offers 3 resource(s) in CSV, XLSX. The portal shows 2025-05-05 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Attribution International (CC BY). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-hdx-humanitarian-data-exchange.
